data.title: Ipswich vs. Nottingham Forest prediction, lineups, odds and bet builder tips for Premier League match | Sporting News
data.content:
Flemming is pushing for a start and he may well line up in attacking midfield with Julio Enciso moved wide as Ipswich become more proactive at home.
 Abdul Fatawu has returned from suspension and is an option for the wide positions, too, albeit Daizen Maeda should keep his spot after scoring last week.
 Lukic did sustain a slight groin injury last week but O'Neil said the Serbia international midfielder would "be fine" for this one.

### Nottingham Forest predicted lineup to play Ipswich [...] Sels (GK) — Jair, Milenkovic, Murillo — Munoz, Schlager, McAtee, Williams — Ndoye, Gibbs-White — Delap

 Morgan Gibbs-White missed the visit of champions Arsenal last week, but the England international has returned to full fitness for this one.
 Forest do still have a couple of confirmed absentees as Igor Jesus remains sidelined alongside wing-back Nicolo Savona.
 Surprisingly, Glasner has preferred Jair Cunha ahead of big-money summer signing Ousmane Diomande in his back three thus far. [...] Walton (GK) — Furlong, O'Shea, Diop, Davis — Palacios, Lukic — Enciso, Flemming, Maeda — Emersonn
